dog.description_text:
Meet Bronx, a calm and loving cat!

Bronx has gentle eyes and a serene expression that is sure to draw you in. One of our favorite things about Bronx is his peaceful nature. He takes in the world with quiet curiosity, content to sit back and observe everything going on around him. Bronx is also incredibly affectionate and laidback. He loves spending time with his people and enjoys being close to those he cares about.

As for hobbies, Bronx enjoys napping near his favorite humans and relaxing with his best friend, Brooklyn, who he is bonded to. Whether he's curled up beside you for a cozy afternoon snooze or sharing a nap with his companion, Bronx is happiest when he's surrounded by the company he loves. His calm presence makes him a wonderful friend and an easy companion to have by your side.

Ready to meet the sweet Bronx and his bestie Brooklyn? Click the “Adopt Me” button to get in touch with us!

*You can meet animals located at the ASPCA Adoption Center during our walk-in hours (daily, noon to 6 p.m.). We encourage a $150 suggested adoption fee when adopting an animal. This adoption fee allows the ASPCA to continue our lifesaving work and help even more animals in need. We are grateful for any amount given at the time of adoption.*
